---
name: Feature request
about: Request a new capability in preserf
labels: []
assignees: ''
---

**Summary**

One or two sentences describing the capability you want.

**Use case**

The problem this solves for you — what you cannot do today, ideally
with the concrete workload or store it applies to.

**Proposed behaviour (optional)**

How you expect it to behave. Sketches are welcome; the maintainers
will decide the shape.

**Alternatives considered (optional)**

Workarounds or other tools you evaluated.
